name: mesh
description: Mesh local-first workspace protocol and desktop client

scripts.test: npm run verify:license && npm run verify:rust && npm run verify:desktop
scripts.verify:rust: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo fmt --all --check && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo nextest run --workspace
